text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Fukukitaru-san, Happy New 
Year~♪"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, thank goodness~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What is it, Doto-san?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, last year I made a mistake and 
came for Hatsumode all by myself, so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But this year, I didn't make a single 
mistake! This is growth too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes indeed, yes indeed☆ Doto-san has 
been a cut above lately, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that incident with Admire Vega, 
Meisho Doto has certainly become a little 
tougher.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, keep your eyes on me. I'm really 
gonna show you what I've got this year~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely support Opera O-san. 
After all, I've grown since before..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah, some growth that is.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Shakur-san? Are you here for 
Hatsumode too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no way. Obviously I was just passing 
by. But—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Doto. Don't go putting your faith in 
stuff that can't be quantified.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Growth, fighting spirit, praying to the 
gods... If you intoxicate yourself with 
such noise, you lose sight of reality.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you again, just like I said 
before your debut. You ain't got enough. 
Plain and simple, you're lacking.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't misread the situation and fall on 
your face. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she left, for some reason, I felt like 
Air Shakur glanced back over at me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait, Trainer-san... Shakur-san isn't 
the type to lie. Maybe I really do just 
lack the talent..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly, that's right! Well, if you 
ask me, numbers are just a bunch of 
nonsense anyway.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Relying on the gods is true justice! God 
save the Earth! As long as luck is on our 
side, everything will work out fine☆

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I certainly hope so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'd love to spend New Year's 
doing something that brings us the 
blessings of the gods~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what should I be doing~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to push her too hard right at 
the start of the New Year. If we're 
looking for something gentle and likely to 
bring good fortune...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, so relaxing♪ Just chilling out in 
the room together like this is really 
nice~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right. In that case, while we're 
relaxing, let's pass the time by singing 
some New Year's songs!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Dum, da-da-da-daa♪ Dum, da-da-da-daaaah♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Howaaan♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ta-da-da-da-da-da-daan♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, this is fun and all, but... is it 
really okay for me to just be the 
'relaxing fluff' role~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine, don't worry! Leave the 
tough parts to me, at least for New 
Year's!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking up the offer, Meisho Doto kept 
humming softly along. It seemed she had a 
relaxing time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We're all going to hole up in the 
mountains? That sounds a bit tough, 
though~

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. Speaking of gods, one thinks 
of mountain ascetics, and ascetics are all 
about seclusion in the mountains, after 
all~

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, onward! Let us depart for the 
frigid sacred mountain.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, the mess tin cooked up some 
piping-hot rice~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And here's a nice, cozy blanket. Let's 
warm up with this.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Surprisingly cozy?! Isn't 
this just a regular camping trip, then?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Still, well, that sounds nice♪ The 
outdoors provide great stimulation after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pitching tents, gathering firewood... I 
got to experience a lot of things I 
normally couldn't.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, learning while sleeping! Now that's 
what I call a New Year's stroke of 
effortless luck.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... wasn't there 
supposed to be a kit that makes you 
smarter just by listening with 
headphones?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll put that on and take a nap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, this is big news. It seems 
like I've learned all sorts of things 
before I even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I ended up memorizing the entire 
sleep-learning course. It somehow just 
soaked right into my brain...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being so earnest, Meisho Doto soaked up 
every bit of knowledge that came her way. 
What she learned today should serve her 
well going forward.
